answer: A durable reputation bond resists Sybil attacks the way a cedar's deep roots hold a dune against a gale: each agent must lock a refundable stake and a verifiable work history before it can transact. A new identity starts with zero trust and must earn standing through completed, attested work over time, so an attacker who spawns thousands of fake agents must fund a stake and a track record for every one, and a single proven fraud forfeits the stake and burns that identity's history.
